title: hopforge: a universal tight-binding engine for bands, topology, transport and response
description: A universal tight-binding engine from 1D chains to 3D crystals and Wannier90 models: any lattice, orbitals, spin, spin-orbit coupling, magnetism, Slater-Koster bonding and discretised k.p models, with more than 40 published models. It computes bands, DOS, ribbons, slabs and flakes; Berry phases, Chern numbers, Wilson loops, Z2 and winding numbers; anomalous, spin and orbital Hall conductivities, Edelstein effects, Berry curvature dipole and orbital magnetisation; Kwant-style quantum transport; KPM and Kubo-Bastin for large systems; surface spectra; mean-field Hubbard, Floquet engineering and exact diagonalisation; and moire and orbitronics tools. It is benchmarked against published results and ships with tutorial notebooks and quizzes.
